parsed.explanation: Known traveller-facing exposures dominate. Border/document processing is the sharpest: X markers not issued, officers instructed to refuse cases with sex discrepancies and consider lifetime fraud ineligibility; trans travellers report passports seized or blocked, and at least eight governments issued advisories after detentions. The division's 2025 statute bars trans people from bathrooms, locker rooms, dormitories, shelters and prisons by birth sex, with criminal trespass enforcement and no documented working remedy; an arrest was recorded elsewhere, and courts have rejected challenges and marker changes. If detained, custody carries documented harm: birth-sex placement, hormone removal, forced labour and sexual abuse in immigration custody. A religious-refusal statute with qualified immunity permits service denial, and there is no statewide anti-discrimination protection. Mitigants: no presentation offence, national hate-crime and employment protections, no documented police sweeps of trans visitors. Net: unremedied universal exclusion plus serious border and custody exposure.
